requests.message: Hi! I'm planning a surprise 40th for my partner this Saturday, about 14 of us, ideally around 7pm. Online only lets me book 8. We'd love one long table so everyone can talk. A couple of guests are vegetarian. Is that possible?

Booking request on behalf of Sam Whitaker: dinner for 22 on Friday at 6:30 PM, family reunion. The group includes one guest who uses a wheelchair and one infant in a stroller, so step-free access and space beside the table are needed. Flexible by 30 minutes.

Team dinner for 30 next Thursday, 7:30pm. We need a private feel (a separate room, no other diners) because there will be a short toast and a few slides on a laptop. Set menu is fine. Please send options and a minimum spend if there is one.
